description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
uses.cardState: as Lisette, Dean of the Root
